# Custom C++ and CUDA Operators — Full Tutorial Extraction

**Source:** PyTorch Tutorials 2.14.0+cu130 | Author: Richard Zou | Created: Jun 18, 2024 | Last Updated: Jan 20, 2026 | Last Verified: Nov 05, 2024

The tutorial demonstrates the "blessed path" to authoring a fused multiply-add custom operator with semantics `mymuladd(a, b, c) = a * b + c`, integrating it with PyTorch subsystems (autograd, `torch.compile`). The end-to-end working example lives in the [extension-cpp repository](https://github.com/pytorch/extension-cpp), with two parallel implementations: `extension_cpp/` (standard ATen/LibTorch API) and `extension_cpp_stable/` (Stable ABI, recommended for PyTorch 2.10+).
